blocks.text: Planning a software project is like planning a trip: you need to know where you are going, how long it will take and how much it will cost. Project planning and management cover the five phases of a project management plan, comprehensive planning, timelines, cost estimation, risk management and quality assurance.

blocks.prompt: Why is planning a software project compared to planning a trip?
blocks.explanation: Both need a clear destination (the goal), an estimate of time (the timeline) and an estimate of cost (the budget) before you set out.

items: Project planning and management: know the goal, the time and the cost before starting, like planning a trip.
Covers the five PM phases, planning, timelines, cost estimation, risk management and quality assurance.
